caption_final:
Seven new films and series reach Indian streaming platforms by this weekend, six of them on Friday, 13 November.

Netflix adds Daayra, Meghna Gulzar's Hindi crime thriller, eight weeks after it opened in cinemas on 18 September, and Heartland, an English thriller set in Nashville.

JioHotstar premieres Student of the Year: After Dark, a Hindi thriller series. Sony LIV releases Parivarik ManuRanjan, a Hindi family comedy made as a Sony LIV original.

ZEE5 adds two regional titles: Bandra, a Malayalam film from 2023, and the Bengali crime thriller Mrigaya 1.5.

Jailer 2 has been on Prime Video since Thursday, 12 November, in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada, in more than 240 countries and territories.

What are you watching first this weekend, and who's watching it with you?
